_comment: Clone request example for namespace-qualified ambiguous Service DNS. Template precondition: target mysql has service primary in default namespace, target redis has service primary in redis-ns, and gateway template text references primary.default.svc.cluster.local plus primary.redis-ns.svc.cluster.local.
name: ambiguous-service-dns-clone
description: Namespace-qualified Service DNS rewrite should not conflict with ambiguous short service names.
